1	/****************************************************************************
2	 * contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/bk7258_start.c
3	 *
4	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5	 *
6	 * Beken BK7258 (T5-AI, tri-core Cortex-M33) C reset entry for NuttX
7	 * Stage N1.
8	 *
9	 * GOAL (Stage N1, minimal):
10	 *   Prove that the NuttX build chain (linker script, vector table, app
11	 *   magic, postbuild CRC-expansion) produces an image that the on-board
12	 *   Tier-1 bootloader can validate and jump into.  When this __start runs,
13	 *   the hardware has already loaded MSP from vector slot [0]; we mask
14	 *   IRQs, relocate VTOR onto our flash-resident table, push the banner
15	 *   "NUTTX N1\r\n" out of UART1 the same way the verified probe does, and
16	 *   spin.  We deliberately do NOT call nx_start().
17	 *
18	 * WHAT IS INTENTIONALLY LEFT FOR STAGE N2:
19	 *   - .data copy from flash LMA and .bss zero-initialisation
20	 *   - arm_earlyserialinit() / console bringup
21	 *   - heap sizing, boardinitialize(), nx_start(), NSH
22	 *   N1 keeps .data/.bss empty (only static-const strings and locals), so
23	 *   skipping those loops is safe here.  N2 will insert the standard
24	 *   mps_start.c-style sequence immediately before the banner.
25	 *
26	 * Freestanding: no libc, no NuttX headers beyond config.h.  The UART1
27	 * addresses and the magic value are shared verbatim with
28	 * docs/bk7258-t5ai/probe/probe.c (board-verified 2026-07-15).
29	 ****************************************************************************/
30	
31	/****************************************************************************
32	 * Included Files
33	 ****************************************************************************/
34	
35	#include <nuttx/config.h>
36	
37	/* We intentionally avoid <stdint.h> here to stay freestanding; the build
38	 * is compiled with -nostdlib/-nostdinc++ equivalents for the libcless
39	 * boot path.  Use compiler-builtin unsigned types.
40	 */
41	
42	/****************************************************************************
43	 * Pre-processor Definitions
44	 ****************************************************************************/
45	
46	/* Fixed memory-mapped registers / words (shared with probe.c). */
47	
48	#define BK7258_SCB_VTOR          (*(volatile unsigned int *)0xe000ed08u)
49	#define BK7258_SCB_CPACR         (*(volatile unsigned int *)0xe000ed88u)
50	
51	/* UART1 FIFO registers.  The Tier-1 bootloader already configured UART1
52	 * (pinmux, 26 MHz XTAL, clock gate, global_ctrl, config); we MUST NOT
53	 * touch UART1_CFG (0x45830010) because that would clash with the
54	 * bootloader's divider.  We only push bytes into fifo_port, exactly like
55	 * the Zephyr soc_reset_hook and our probe.
56	 */
57	
58	#define BK7258_UART1_FIFO_STAT   (*(volatile unsigned int *)0x45830018u)
59	#define BK7258_UART1_FIFO_PORT   (*(volatile unsigned int *)0x4583001Cu)
60	#define BK7258_UART1_FIFO_READY  (1u << 20)
61	
62	/* Our vector table lives at the very start of the app image, which the
63	 * bootloader maps at logical flash address 0x02010000.  Tell VTOR to
64	 * fetch exceptions from there.
65	 */
66	
67	#define BK7258_VTOR_VALUE        0x02010000u
68	
69	/* Idle-stack top symbol exported by the linker script.  The common ARM
70	 * code (arm_initialize, arm_getintstack) expects g_idle_topstack to exist
71	 * even though N1 never reaches nx_start; provide it as a read-only
72	 * constant so the link succeeds.  Value matches the canonical
73	 * "_ebss + CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE" convention used by other CM33
74	 * chips (mps_start.c).  Because N1's .bss is empty, _ebss == _sbss ==
75	 * start of RAM (0x28000000) + an 0x0-length .data/.bss; the post-link
76	 * value is computed by ld and emitted into the const.
77	 */
78	
79	extern unsigned int _ebss;
80	
81	/****************************************************************************
82	 * Public Data
83	 ****************************************************************************/
84	
85	/* Referenced by nuttx/arch/arm/src/common/arm_initialize.c via
86	 * up_get_idle_stack().  Defined here because N1 ships its own start file
87	 * instead of reusing mps_start.c.  Const so it lands in .rodata (flash).
88	 */
89	
90	const unsigned int g_idle_topstack =
91	    (unsigned int)&_ebss + 2048;  /* CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048 */
92	
93	/****************************************************************************
94	 * Private Functions
95	 ****************************************************************************/
96	
97	/* Polled UART1 output -- identical to probe.c. */
98	
99	static void bk7258_uart_putc(unsigned char c)
100	{
101	  while ((BK7258_UART1_FIFO_STAT & BK7258_UART1_FIFO_READY) == 0)
102	    {
103	    }
104	
105	  BK7258_UART1_FIFO_PORT = (unsigned int)(c & 0xffu);
106	}
107	
108	static void bk7258_uart_puts(const char *s)
109	{
110	  while (*s)
111	    {
112	      bk7258_uart_putc((unsigned char)*s);
113	      s++;
114	    }
115	}
116	
117	/****************************************************************************
118	 * Public Functions
119	 ****************************************************************************/
120	
121	/****************************************************************************
122	 * Name: __start
123	 *
124	 * Description:
125	 *   Cortex-M reset entry.  Reached from vector slot [1] after the
126	 *   bootloader validated the BK7236 magic at image offset 0x100 and jumped
127	 *   in.  The hardware has already loaded MSP from slot [0]; we run with
128	 *   interrupts whatever the bootloader left them at -- first instruction
129	 *   masks them.
130	 *
131	 ****************************************************************************/
132	
133	void __start(void)
134	{
135	  /* 1. Mask all interrupts immediately. */
136	
137	  __asm volatile ("cpsid i");
138	
139	  /* 2. Point VTOR at our flash-resident vector table (0x02010000).  The
140	   *    bootloader may or may not have set this; make it deterministic.
141	   *    Barrier so subsequent exception entry (if ever enabled in N2)
142	   *    observes the new VTOR.
143	   */
144	
145	  BK7258_SCB_VTOR = BK7258_VTOR_VALUE;
146	  __asm volatile ("dsb; isb");
147	
148	  /* 3. Enable CP10/CP11 (FPU) full access.  Cheap and matches the probe;
149	   *    avoids accidental traps if the toolchain emits FP prologues.
150	   */
151	
152	  BK7258_SCB_CPACR = BK7258_SCB_CPACR | ((3u << 20) | (3u << 22));
153	
154	  /* 4. Push the N1 banner.  This is the proof-of-life: if we see this
155	   *    string on UART1 (115200 8N1, inherited from the bootloader), the
156	   *    NuttX image was validated by the bootloader and __start executed.
157	   *
158	   *    N2 will replace this block with .data/.bss init +
159	   *    arm_earlyserialinit() + nx_start().
160	   */
161	
162	  bk7258_uart_puts("NUTTX N1\r\n");
163	
164	  /* 5. Halt forever.  N1 does not start the scheduler. */
165	
166	  for (; ; )
167	    {
168	    }
169	}

name: bk7258-nuttx-boot-core-verified
description: BK7258 NuttX baseline boots on CPU0 (board-verified 2026-07-17); probe + Tier-1 bootloader + NuttX Stage N1 all validated; NuttX __start runs via our bootloader.
metadata:
  type: project
---

2026-07-17 板端验证三个里程碑（均 ✅）：

**(1) 最小裸探针**：烧 logical 0x02010000（物理 0x11000）被 bootloader 跳转执行 → **NuttX baseline boot 在 CPU0**（bootloader 跳转核）。解决 SDK vs 上下文核号矛盾：**CPU0=CP/boot master（非 AP）；CPU1/CPU2=AP/被唤醒副核**（SDK 分区表 `primary_cp_app`@0x02010000 + `startup_cpu0.c`"app"(master) vs `startup_cpu1.c`"app@cpu1"(副核)；多核唤醒 100% 在 app 层 `start_cpu1_core`）。

**(2) Tier-1 bootloader**（混合 asm 跳板 + C main `boot_main.c` + asm 硬化 epilogue，落 `board/bk7258_t5ai/bootloader/`）：特性 I 日志 / J 硬化跳转(VTOR/dsb/isb/MSP/清r0-r12/bx) / A FAL 分区表解析(magic `0x45503130`/64B，按名找 app)。最小 bl（`$ZEPHYR_PORT/out/custom_bootloader/bk7236_min_bl_crc.bin`）作回退。

**(3) NuttX Stage N1（2026-07-17 板端通过）**：NuttX 构建产最小镜像，bootloader 跳进去后 `__start` 打印 `NUTTX N1`。证明 NuttX 构建链（linker/向量表+magic/postbuild）端到端工作。结构：自定义 chip 在 `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/`（`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM_DIR`，`bk7258_vectors.c` 自有向量表 slot0=MSP/slot1=__start/slot64-65=magic + `bk7258_start.c` `__start` 裸 UART 打印+hang，**先不调 nx_start**）；board 在 `board/bk7258_t5ai/{configs/nsh/defconfig,scripts/ld.script(FLASH 0x02010000),src,include}`；manifest 新增 linkfile `board/bk7258_t5ai → vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_135_bk7258`（**不能复用 contest_board 的 slot，那是 RV1126B**）；构建 `./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_135_bk7258/configs/nsh -j8`（classic Make 后端）。**关键 CONFIG：`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ARM_CUSTOM=y`**（ARM 自定义 chip 的选择项成员，缺了会默认选 STM32）。chip Kconfig `select ARCH_CORTEXM33 + ARCH_HAVE_CUSTOM_VECTORS`（弃用共享 arm_vectors.c）。defconfig 关键：`CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_ARM_CUSTOM`、`CONFIG_RAW_BINARY`。

共用底层（N1/bl/探针复用；产物 `docs/bk7258-t5ai/{probe,bootloader}` + `board/bk7258_t5ai/`；板端实测文档 `$ZEPHYR_PORT/docs/12-custom-bootloader.md`；模板 `open-vela/vendor_beken` BK7236N 只看外壳不抄 Armino 闭源库）：
- FLASH bl@`0x02000000`(物理0x0) / app@`0x02010000`(物理0x11000)；RAM `0x28000000`(0xA0000)；SP `0x2809FFFC`(app探针/bl基线 `0x2809F700`)
- app magic `"BK7236\0\0"` 是 **vector table 槽 64/65**（`0x32374B42`/`0x00003633`，字节偏移 0x100）；bl magic `"BK7236\x10\x00"`@logical 0x100
- **UART1 console 波特率 = 460800**（bootloader config `0x00003719`/clk_div=0x37 @26MHz → 26M/56≈464k，终端 460800）。打印**继承 bootloader config 不要重写**（重写 clk_div 会改波特率）；fifo 写 `0x4583001C` 轮询 `0x45830018` bit20
- 烧录 Windows-only `bk_loader.exe`，`--mainBin-multi 路径@偏移-长度`（长度非结束）。**all-app.bin 整体烧**（决策）：`cat bl_crc.bin(0x11000) + nuttx_crc.bin → all-app.bin` 烧 @0x0；app 物理偏移 0x11000；WSL UNC `//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu-22.04/...`
- flash 物理 32B+2B CRC16；开源 packer（`bk7258_crc_expand_app.py` app / `bk7236_pack_min_bootloader.py` bl）**字节等价** Beken 闭源 `cmake_encrypt_crc`（poly 0x8005/init 0xFFFF/不反射/BE，9 输入 byte-identical）
- print_hex 用 `for(s=28;s>=0;s-=4)`，避免 `v>>32` ARM-UB

下一步：**N2** = nx_start kernel + UART1 console（460800）→ NSH；再 Tier-2 bootloader（OTA RBL / A-B failover）；再多核 SMP。RV1126B 是另一块板（见 [[rv1126b-openvela-contest-context]]），文档隔离。

125	 * Name: __start
126	 *
127	 * Description:
128	 *   Cortex-M reset entry.  Reached from vector slot [1] after the
129	 *   bootloader validated the BK7236 magic at image offset 0x100 and jumped
130	 *   in.  The hardware has already loaded MSP from slot [0]; we run with
131	 *   interrupts whatever the bootloader left them at -- first instruction
132	 *   masks them.
133	 *
134	 ****************************************************************************/
135	
136	void __start(void)
137	{
138	#ifndef CONFIG_BUILD_PIC
139	  const uint32_t *src;
140	  uint32_t       *dest;
141	#endif
142	
143	  /* 1. Mask all interrupts immediately. */
144	
145	  __asm volatile ("cpsid i");
146	
147	  /* 2. Point VTOR at our flash-resident vector table (0x02010000).  The
148	   *    bootloader may or may not have set this; make it deterministic.
149	   *    Barrier so subsequent exception entry observes the new VTOR.
150	   */
151	
152	  BK7258_SCB_VTOR = BK7258_VTOR_VALUE;
153	  __asm volatile ("dsb; isb");
154	
155	  /* 3. Enable CP10/CP11 (FPU) full access.  Cheap and matches the probe;
156	   *    avoids accidental traps if the toolchain emits FP prologues.  We do
157	   *    not rely on CONFIG_ARCH_FPU/arm_fpuconfig() here so that N2 boots
158	   *    identically whether or not the FPU Kconfig is selected.
159	   */
160	
161	  BK7258_SCB_CPACR = BK7258_SCB_CPACR | ((3u << 20) | (3u << 22));
162	  __asm volatile ("dsb; isb");
163	
164	  /* 4. Early proof-of-life marker.  Pushed before .data/.bss init because it
165	   *    touches only MMIO; lets the board-side operator confirm __start was
166	   *    reached even if console bring-up later hangs.
167	   */
168	
169	  bk7258_early_puts("N2\r\n");
170	
171	#ifndef CONFIG_BUILD_PIC
172	  /* 5. Copy the .data image from flash (LMA == _eronly) to its RAM VMA
173	   *    (_sdata.._edata).  The BK7258 boots with a copy of NuttX kernel +
174	   *    NSH, so .data is no longer empty (unlike N1) and this copy is
175	   *    mandatory.
176	   */
177	
178	  for (src = (const uint32_t *)_eronly,
179	       dest = (uint32_t *)_sdata; dest < (uint32_t *)_edata; )
180	    {
181	      *dest++ = *src++;
182	    }
183	
184	  /* 6. Zero the .bss section (_sbss.._ebss). */
185	
186	#ifndef CONFIG_ARCH_SKIP_ZERO_BSS
187	  for (dest = (uint32_t *)_sbss; dest < (uint32_t *)_ebss; )
188	    {

190	    }

194	  /* 7. Perform early serial initialisation so the console is available
195	   *    during the rest of boot.  arm_earlyserialinit() is only compiled
